counter_sensitivity_read_only.interpretation: Equal registered nominal analytic training FLOPs is supported. Exact equal executed GPU arithmetic is not established. Under this source-dense sensitivity, candidates use about3.0–3.2% more arithmetic than the recurrent baselines and about0.25–0.45% less than softmax at the same registered nominal budget.
limits: The old nominal convention charges two Parallax value products even though JAX already combines their weights into one product; a ta-to-T substitution alone overstates source arithmetic.
A assumes the duplicate ordinary W@V expression is shared, consistent with the declared counter and the CPU HLO check; GPU code was not profiled.
Scalar costs remain estimates. The common3x-forward approximation, special chunk solve backward surcharge, and exclusions of optimizer/rematerialization arithmetic remain unchanged.
A positive language result should be described as satisfying the preregistered nominal-FLOP gate, not proof of equality in hardware-executed FLOPs.
